FOR THE ALLEGED OFFENCE P/U/S.498-A OF IPC AND SEC.3 AND 4 OF DP ACT 1961, FILED BY THE THIRTHAHALLI POLICE,
ON THE FILE OF PRINCIPAL CIVIL JUDGE (JR. DN.) AND J.M.F.C., THIRTHAHALLI.
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER

The petitioners - husband and his family members are before this Court calling in question registration of a crime in Crime No.158/2023, pending before the Principal Civil Judge (Jr. Dn.) and JMFC, Theerthahalli, for the offences under Section 498A of the IPC along with Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners and respondent No.2, in unison would submit that the parties to the lis were before the concerned family Court in M.C.No.33/2024 and during the pendency of this petition, they have obtained a decree of divorce on mutual consent at the hands of the concerned Court on 30.09.2024.
The parties have also arrived at settlement by drawing up certain terms and conditions.
One such conditions also recognizes closure of the impugned crime.
NC: 2024:KHC:51047 An application under Section 320 of the Cr.P.C. and a joint memo is also filed before this Court to that effect.

3. The joint memo reads as follows:
"1. The petitioner No.1 shall pay the for the payment of Rs.7,25,000-00 as permanent alimony to the respondent No.2. as full and final settlement.

Accordingly the petitioners have paid the said amount to the respondent No.2 on the 31-7-2024 before the court of J.M.F.C at Thirthalli, in C.Misc.No.244/2023 and the respondent No.2 received the same and also agreed that she has no claim in future against the petitioners.

2. After receiving the above said amount the marriage between the respondent No.2 and petitioner No.1 is dissolved by a decree of divorce by mutual consent in M.C.No.33/2024 by judgement and decree dated 30-9- 2024.

3. Further the respondent No.2 has withdrawn the Crl.Misc. Petition No.244/2023 filed under section 20(1)
(a) 23 (1) (2) of Domestic Violence Act against the petitioner.
Shashikumar J.P vs State By Thirthahalli Police on 10 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142449759/
3 4.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The respondent No.2 has no objection allow this Criminal Petition to quash the criminal case registered in Crime No.158/2023 registered by the Thirthalli Police."

In the light of the fact that the parties have arrived at settlement and have already parted their ways and as it is a matrimonial dispute, I deem it appropriate to accept the application and joint memo and terminate the proceedings against the petitioners, as the allegations are not against the State.

For the aforesaid reasons, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) The criminal petition is disposed.

(ii) The impugned Crime No.158/2023, pending before the Principal Civil Judge (Jr.
Dn.) and JMFC, Theerthahalli, stands quashed.

Sd/-
